messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
சற்று ஓய்வு எடுத்த பின் என் சோர்வான உடல், நான் மீண்டும் புறநகர் சரிவில் பாதையைத் தொடர்ந்தேன், அப்படியே உறுதியான கால் எப்போதும் கீழே இருந்தது.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Tamil)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Tamil) | Back‑Translation (Eng) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | **Poi** | temporal adverb “after” | **பின்** | after | OK | | **ch'èi** | “that I” (conj. + aux.) | – (subject omitted, implied) | – | UNNECESSARY | | **posato** | verb “rested” (perfect) | **ஓய்வு எடுத்த** | rested | OK | | **un** | indefinite article “a” | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | **poco** | adverb of quantity “little” | **சற்று** | a little | OK | | **il** | definite article “the” | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | **corpo** | noun “body” | **உடல்** | body | OK | | **lasso** | adjective “weary” | **சோர்வான** | weary | OK | | **ripresi** | verb “resumed / took again” | **தொடர்ந்தேன்** | resumed / continued | OK | | **via** | noun “way, path” | **பாதையைத்** | the way | OK | | **per** | preposition “along” (case‑marked) | **சரிவில்** | on / along | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | **piaggia** | noun “slope, hillside” | **சரிவு** | slope | OK | | **diserta** | adjective “deserted, empty” | **புறநகர்** | outskirts / deserted (≈) | **WRONG** | | **sì** | adverb/conj. “so (that)” | **அப்படியே** | so (resultative) | OK | | **che** | conjunction “that” (introducing result clause) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | **'l** | definite article “the” (before *piè*) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | **piè** | noun “foot” (the firm one) | **கால்** | foot | OK | | **fermo** | adjective “firm, steady” | **உறுதியான** | firm | OK | | **sempre** | adverb “always” | **எப்போதும்** | always | OK | | **era** | imperfect of *essere* “was” | **இருந்தது** | was | OK | | **'l** | definite article “the” (before *più*) | – | – | UNNECESSARY | | **più** | comparative particle “more” (used with *basso*) | – (comparative expressed by *கீழே*) | – | UNNECESSARY | | **basso** | adjective “lower” (comparative) | **கீழே** | lower | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
| Status | Source Word(s) | Issue | |--------|----------------|-------| | **WRONG** | **diserta** | Rendered as **புறநகர்** (“outskirts”), which does not convey the sense of “deserted / empty”. A more accurate Tamil rendering would be **வெறிச்சூழல்** or **வெறிச்சரிவு**. | | **UNNECESSARY** | ch'èi, un, il, la, 'l (×4), più, che | Italian articles, conjunctions, and the comparative particle have no direct equivalents in Tamil; their omission is natural. | | **UNNECESSARY** | (implicit) subject pronoun for “I” (ch'èi) | Tamil often drops the explicit subject when the verb inflection already indicates it. |
No **MISSING** or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected; all required meanings are present in the Tamil translation, and agreement (gender/number) is appropriate for Tamil.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 28: - Original: Poi ch'èi posato un poco il corpo lasso, - Issue: none - Corrected: சற்று ஓய்வு எடுத்த பின் என் சோர்வான உடல், - Line 29: - Original: ripresi via per la piaggia diserta, - Issue: WRONG – “diserta” was rendered as “புறநகர்” (outskirts) which does not convey “deserted”. It should express a deserted slope. - Corrected: நான் மீண்டும் வெறிச்சரிவில் பாதையை எடுத்தேன், - Line 30: - Original: sì che 'l piè fermo sempre era 'l più basso. - Issue: none - Corrected: அப்படியே உறுதியான கால் எப்போதும் கீழே இருந்தது.
``` சற்று ஓய்வு எடுத்த பின் என் சோர்வான உடல், நான் மீண்டும் வெறிச்சரிவில் பாதையை எடுத்தேன், அப்படியே உறுதியான கால் எப்போதும் கீழே இருந்தது. ```
